item.description: Men and women in Ragiampun Village, Umi LLG, have joined forces to prepare their land for a new cocoa project supported by the South Pacific Institute for Sustainable Agriculture and Rural Development (SPISARD). The community recently gathered to clear overgrown grass and rehabilitate their cocoa garden sites ahead of the distribution of cocoa seedlings.
